verdict.rationale: Payout scheduling and per-payout reconciliation are a fair axis for a payment processor like Flutterwave, but the evidence pack never documents settlement schedule controls or a payout breakdown showing charges, fees, and refunds. The available evidence covers adjacent features only: payout event webhooks, outbound transfers, and split payments. None of these are the requested capability.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
